title: PROMPT OPTIMIZATION ACROSS MULTIPLE AGENTS FOR REPRESENTING DIVERSE HUMAN POPULATIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the representation gap (L2 distance) between simulated LLM agent responses and actual human survey responses on political questions from the OpinionQA dataset, analyzing how well agents capture diverse political ideologies and party affiliations.

bias_targets.target: Skill level and Cognitive representation bias (Hyper-accuracy distortion)
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the representation gap (Hamming distance) between LLM agent predictions and the actual performance of a diverse student population with varying skill levels and math misconceptions using the EEDI dataset.

Computing the representation gap (L2 distance) between the affective response embeddings of constructed agents and synthetic human annotators modeled with diverse Big Five personality traits on the WikiArt dataset.
